name: Endurain
author: joaovitoriasilva
description: Endurain is a self-hosted fitness tracking service designed to give users full control over their data and hosting environment.

form_fields.label: Secret key
form_fields.hint: v0.21.0 and newer require at least 32 characters with at least 10 distinct ones, and refuse the example value published in Endurain's docs.

form_fields.label: Trusted proxies
form_fields.hint: Required from v0.21.0 because this app runs Endurain behind a proxy: IPs, CIDR ranges or hostnames of your reverse proxy, comma separated, never *. The default trusts the private ranges Docker and Runtipi's proxy use; narrow it to runtipi-reverse-proxy if you want it tighter.
